description: Reviews digline commands that spend model calls, write under .digline/, or expose a way to change the approved baseline. digline is a regression gate for LLM applications, the approved reference lives in your repo.
name: digline command protection
saferAlternatives: Read existing runs with digline list, compare, diff, explain, log, or report before producing or approving new ones.
Run digline migrate --dry-run before migrating, and commit .digline/ before any command that rewrites it.
